applies_why: This text decides a link collision by separating the challenger's wording point from the defender's application point rather than comparing the chains by footing.
quote: Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
room: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse -- two readings: (1) the judge must compare the support of the whole chains; (2) the judge may separate a wording issue from an application issue and mark the link underdetermined if each side addressed a different issue.
why: The judge declares the link underdetermined by matching a wording answer to an application answer, which is an aspect-by-aspect comparison rather than the required chain-against-chain footing analysis.
